seoTitle: Fifth Glorious Mystery: The Coronation of Mary | Rosary Book
seoDescription: A read-aloud decade book for children on the Fifth Glorious Mystery, the Coronation of Mary: the story, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a reflection.
h1: The Coronation of Mary: Fifth Glorious Mystery
intro: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Coronation of Mary.
shortAnswer: This book walks children through the Fifth Glorious Mystery, the Coronation of Mary: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on perseverance and trust in Mary's intercession.
aboutHtml:
Painting: Diego Velázquez, Coronation of the Virgin (Prado). Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Image source (Wikimedia Commons).

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Wednesday / Sunday.

The crown of twelve stars in Revelation 12 is the traditional Scripture sign for this mystery; the Church celebrates Mary as Queen of heaven and earth.

faq.q: What is the Fifth Glorious Mystery?
faq.a: The Coronation of Mary. In heaven, Jesus crowned his mother as Queen of heaven and earth. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Wednesday / Sunday, and its fruit is perseverance and trust in Mary's intercession.

faq.q: How do you pray this decade with children?
faq.a: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
